examples.question: What is the session idle timeout for an operator?
examples.answer: An operator session expires after eight hours of inactivity. Administrators can revoke an active session from the access console.

citations.title: Authentication and sessions
citations.quote: An operator session expires after eight hours of inactivity. Administrators can revoke an active session from the access console.

examples.question: Which role can create redacted exports?
examples.answer: The Operator role can update assigned cases and create redacted exports. The Administrator role manages users, roles, retention settings, and routing rules.

citations.title: Roles and access review
citations.quote: The Operator role can update assigned cases and create redacted exports. The Administrator role manages users, roles, retention settings, and routing rules.

examples.question: What are the required import columns?
examples.answer: Use a CSV file encoded as UTF-8 with a header row. The required columns are case_id, customer_region, opened_at, and summary.

citations.title: Importing service records
citations.quote: Use a CSV file encoded as UTF-8 with a header row. The required columns are case_id, customer_region, opened_at, and summary.

examples.question: Do routing edits move existing cases automatically?
examples.answer: Routing changes take effect for newly created cases only. Existing cases keep their current owner until reassigned.

citations.title: Case routing rules
citations.quote: Routing changes take effect for newly created cases only. Existing cases keep their current owner until reassigned.

examples.question: How frequently must customers receive an outage update?
examples.answer: Create an incident when a service outage affects more than one customer or when sensitive data may have been exposed. The incident commander records the start time, impact, owner, and next update time.

citations.title: Incident response
citations.quote: Create an incident when a service outage affects more than one customer or when sensitive data may have been exposed. The incident commander records the start time, impact, owner, and next update time.

examples.question: What does a legal hold prevent?
examples.answer: An Administrator can place a legal hold on a case. A legal hold prevents scheduled deletion until the hold is removed.

citations.title: Retention and deletion
citations.quote: An Administrator can place a legal hold on a case. A legal hold prevents scheduled deletion until the hold is removed.

examples.question: When does an export link expire?
examples.answer: An export link expires after twenty-four hours. Downloading an export creates an audit event with the report identifier and operator identifier.

citations.title: Reports and exports
citations.quote: An export link expires after twenty-four hours. Downloading an export creates an audit event with the report identifier and operator identifier.

examples.question: How many downstream retries does ingestion use?
examples.answer: The ingestion worker retries a transient downstream failure up to three times using exponential backoff. A failed final attempt creates a case for General Review.

citations.title: Availability targets
citations.quote: The ingestion worker retries a transient downstream failure up to three times using exponential backoff. A failed final attempt creates a case for General Review.

examples.question: How many resolved cases are sampled per Operator each month?
examples.answer: Supervisors sample ten resolved cases per Operator each month. A review checks that the category, customer region, and resolution notes agree with the case evidence.

citations.title: Quality review
citations.quote: Supervisors sample ten resolved cases per Operator each month. A review checks that the category, customer region, and resolution notes agree with the case evidence.

examples.question: For how long does the notification service deduplicate an event identifier?
examples.answer: The notification service deduplicates notifications by event identifier for thirty days. A delivery failure is retried twice before it is recorded for follow-up.

citations.title: Notifications
citations.quote: The notification service deduplicates notifications by event identifier for thirty days. A delivery failure is retried twice before it is recorded for follow-up.
